tools.name: lookup_term
tools.description: Look up an exact published slang term, slug, or alias. Includes sources, maturity, canonical URL, and ambiguity. Never generates a meaning.

tools.name: search_terms
tools.description: Search published names, aliases, and summaries. No web search or generation.

tools.name: decode_phrase
tools.description: Find documented slang in a phrase. Preserves ambiguity; not an interpretation of speaker intent. Text is sent to this reference server, never to an LLM.

tools.name: compare_usage
tools.description: Return documented regional, register, and disambiguation notes for an exact term. Missing regional evidence is not invented.

tools.name: get_related_terms
tools.description: Read published related terms for an exact term or alias.

tools.name: get_recent_terms
tools.description: Get recent published dictionary summaries, with an optional adult-language filter.
